title: Graduation Day-2021
content:
Graduation Day-2021

ATME College of Engineering Celebrated the Graduation Day on 25th Aug 2021. The main  purpose of a Graduation ceremony is to celebrate students who have successfully met the  academic and extracurricular requirements for graduation. The ceremony provides a  public venue in which graduating students receive their Course completion certificate,  marking their official graduation from the institution. In the celebration about 600 students from the AY 2019-20 & AY 2020-21 passed out  batches were present in the event. Brief of the Event:  The ceremony begins with the entry of the procession with Honourable Guests Dr. J  Shashidhar Prasad, Former Vice-Chancellor, University of Mysore and Mr. Raghavendra  Kadkol, Senior Principal, Employee Relations, Infosys along with the Governing Council  members of the Institution enters the auditorium and respects the National anthem and  Nadageethe. Principal Sir welcomed the dignitaries, Guests and governing council members and gave  a brief report about the institution. Then Honourable Chairman opened the graduation  day, after that department wise students were called to receive the course completion  certificate. Institute celebrated the Graduation day by following the SOP issued by  Government of Karnataka. Whole event was streamed on YouTube for the public and Many parents were facilitated  to watch the event celebration in live streaming at several ICT enabled classrooms in the  campus. Class wise group photos were captured where the all the staffs of the departments, Deans,  Principal and management members were present.
